svg.title: One output tile, several reduction stages, two ordering edges
svg.text: One output tile, several reduction stages, two ordering edges
Global A/B panels → shared slots → publication barrier
Load valid coordinates; initialize invalid panel positions to zero before readers proceed.
Published panels → thread operands → register accumulators
Reuse A across output columns and B across rows; retain each output sum across stages.
Last panel readers → reuse barrier → next stage overwrite
All configured block threads participate. Store only valid C coordinates after all stages.
Ordinary staging can use intermediate registers; asynchronous paths have separate contracts.
Shared publication does not establish global completion or permit early output-buffer reclamation.
